Eurozone Inflation Reaches Three-Year High Amid Energy Price Surge

Eurozone inflation rose to 3.3% in August, reaching a near three-year high, driven significantly by an energy price surge. This development precedes an upcoming European Central Bank (ECB) meeting. The increase in inflation was reported by multiple international news outlets, with specific figures cited for August. The situation in Europe's bond markets is also noted as experiencing a post-holiday shock.
